sindh_police_heinous.name: Crimes committed in Sindh, 2011-2014 (compiled from Sindh Police monthly heinous crime reports)
sindh_police_heinous.publisher: Sindh Police (republished on opendata.com.pk by Computer-Human Interaction and Social Experience Lab (CHISEL) @ LUMS)
sindh_police_heinous.notes: Original source cited by the portal: http://www.sindhpolice.gov.pk/annoucements/henious_crime_reports.html. Measures: Murder; Murder in the form of target killing; Murder during dacoity/robbery. Some months were not in the original files and the compiler filled them with a formula from cumulative figures (their Notes column: e.g. January 2011 for all districts; some March values; S.B. Abad and Sanghar July-August 2014; June 2014). These compiler-derived values are kept as published but flagged here: Data for June 2014 was not availabe, and neither was data for August 2014 available for district N. Feroze. Furthermore, the cumulative data for July 2014 for N.Feroze was 0, which could not have been possible as crimes had been committed in previous months of 2014. Thus we disregard the data for July 2014 for N.Feroze as well, and use the formula: (Sept Cuml-May Cuml- September value)/3. this gives us new values for June, July and August  for N. Feroze; Data for S.B Abad was not available for July or August 2014, so we applied the usual formula: (September Cumulative- June Cumulative - September Value)/2 . One possible reason for these missing values might be the disruption of regular activities due to these three districts (S.B Abad and N.Feroze) being transferred to a new division, the S.B Abad Range. After the new division was created in September 2014, recording of values continued;

problems: All district data are from opendata.com.pk (LUMS CHISEL lab portal) re-publications of official tables; original government pages (punjabpolice.gov.pk, sindhpolice.gov.pk, balochistanpolice.gov.pk) were unreachable or refused requests from here (punjabpolice.gov.pk and balochistanpolice.gov.pk: no connection; sindhpolice.gov.pk: HTTP 403). Name matching to geoBoundaries ADM2 (2019 districts) used abbreviation aliases (D.I. Khan, D.G.Khan, M.B.Din, R.Y.Khan, T.T.Singh, N. Feroze, S.B Abad/Shaheed Benazirabad -> Nawabshah, T.A Yar, T.M Khan, Dir Lower/Upper) and spelling matches: Sheikhupura -> Sheikhpura; Vehari -> Vihari; Kamber Shahdadkot -> Qambar Shahdadkot; Matyari -> Matiari. Districts absent from the geoBoundaries layer (Chiniot, Nankana Sahib, Tor Ghar, Sajawal, Larkana) and Karachi police zones are unmatched.
